title: Polynomial-time unary multiplication
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^*\to\mathbb{N}$ be such that the unary word of length $f(x)$ is polynomial-time computable. For every fixed natural number $k$, the unary word of length $k f(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: The unary encoding of $f$ is polynomial-time computable
replaced: If a unary value is polynomial-time computable, then for every fixed constant $k$ the unary word of $k$ times that value is polynomial-time computable by $k$ native concatenations; the coefficient lives in finite control.
